d:
Karoron rupye ka chanda, lekin 2024-25 men 15 pramukh RUPPs ke pas kul siten rahin shuny. ye aham jankari samne aaee hai ediaar ki naee risarch riport men, jismen rajistard anrikagnaizd politikal partiz yani RUPPs ke vitt varsh 2024-25 ke vittiy byore ka vishleshan kiya gaya hai.
Isse pahle sitanbar 2026 men bibisi hindi ne bhi 2023-24 men sabse zyada chanda pane vali chhah RUPPs ki partal ki thi. is riport ke bad in partiyon ko lekar kaee saval uthe aur efaaaeeaar bhi darj hueen.
